evidence.quote: Decision: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer.

observations.why: The word 'Decision:' performs the settling — it ratifies a conclusion the speaker expects others to act on, not merely a position being argued.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion.

observations.why: A flat unhedged statement of purpose supporting the prior decision — asserted and ready to defend, but not itself performing ratification.
